headline: Nvidia ends week down 12.75% ahead of Tuesday earnings
summary: Nvidia fell about 2% Friday, 12.75% for the week; Tuesday's report is the first read on demand since the CEO change.

headline: HSBC downgrades Nvidia to Hold after Huang exit
summary: HSBC cut its target to $170 from $365, saying investor confidence is shaken. The stock fell again Friday, extending Thursday's 4% drop.

headline: OpenAI reportedly raising $15B at $1.25T valuation
summary: Half the $30B initially sought and below a $1.4T target, per CNBC sources. About 47% above the March round's $852B post-money.

headline: Meta rises about 2% against falling Nasdaq
summary: Meta traded higher midday Friday on light volume while chips dragged the index lower.

headline: 10y yield hits 5.17%, Fed hike bets build
summary: October PPI rose 0.3% vs 0.4% expected, but yields stayed above 5.1% and December hike odds rose.

headline: Robinhood among six brokers selling Anthropic IPO shares to retail
summary: Robinhood joins Schwab, Fidelity, SoFi, E*TRADE and others in the retail allocation; HOOD rose 4% on Nov 12.

headline: Nvidia closes down 4.3% after Huang resigns; Kress interim CEO
summary: Fell as much as 14% intraday before paring. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO; Harvey Jones becomes first board chair. Bernstein halved its target. Q3 results still due Nov 17.

headline: Nvidia down 11% since Nov 6 and 31% below its Oct 6 record
summary: Market value finished about $4.0T. Index funds fell about 0.35%; small caps (IWM) fell 1.6%.

headline: 10-year yield jumps 13bp to 5.125%; December Fed hike fully priced
summary: 2-year up 15bp to 4.879%. Goldman added a March hike. WTI +2% to $88.74, Brent +3% to $95.82 after Trump said no Iran deal needed.

headline: Robinhood October: $383B platform assets, 28.9M funded customers
summary: Monthly operating data released; shares fell 3.8% on the day.

headline: Jensen Huang resigns; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
summary: Huang left as CEO and director effective immediately. Harvey Jones becomes first board chair and the board is searching inside and outside for a permanent CEO.

headline: Figure Q3: marketplace volume +135%, EBITDA margin 58%
summary: Adjusted EBITDA rose 91%. Management flagged seasonal and acquisition costs pressuring Q4 margins; shares rose about 10%.

headline: Alibaba drops about 7% on China AI chip worries
summary: ADRs fell midday as Nvidia's leadership shock revived chip-supply concerns; T-Head has filed for a Hong Kong IPO and results land Nov 19.

headline: AMD up ~5% as rivals gain on Nvidia exit; BofA target $700
summary: William Blair upgraded to Outperform; AMD to invest in PsiQuantum.

headline: Broadcom up ~5% on rotation from Nvidia
summary: Custom-chip makers bid as Nvidia shares fell.

headline: Astera sees Scorpio X above $1B run rate by end-2026
summary: Said at BMO conference; rising silicon content per XPU.

headline: Vertiv launches PowerNexus medium-voltage UPS for AI sites
summary: Outdoor-rated MV system; shares +2.7%.

headline: Four brokers cut Sea targets after Q3 EPS miss
summary: BofA $110, TD Cowen $90, StoneX $155, Barclays $150.

headline: Anthropic IPO reportedly several times oversubscribed
summary: Bloomberg-sourced reports say orders are several times the 825M shares on offer at $70-78; up to $90.4B raised including a private placement; pricing Nov 18, Nasdaq trading as ANT Nov 19. Talk of a valuation above the range.

headline: OpenAI's direct model supply to Cursor due to end today
summary: OpenAI proposed Nov 12 as the date to wind down its direct model-supply deal with Cursor, which SpaceX now owns. Not confirmed by a primary source.

headline: WSJ: Nvidia board preparing to oust Huang
summary: Board could meet Wednesday night; no successor or board chair. NYT also reported a second relationship, with an executive. Shares down over 7% after hours. No decision reported yet.

headline: Micron up 11.9% on CoreWeave beat and Anthropic allocation
summary: CoreWeave revenue up 168% with a $132.5B backlog revived the memory trade; amended Anthropic IPO filing names Micron for a $1B placement allocation.

headline: Chips lead rebound: S&P tech sector up 2.7%
summary: Marvell up 9.3%, TSMC up 4.3%, Nvidia up 2.9% in session before the after-hours drop. S&P 500 up 1.3%, Nasdaq up 1.6%.

headline: Apple closes at record high, China Renaissance upgrades to Buy
summary: Shares rose about 2% to about $355.63, an all-time closing high, for a market value of about $5.1T. China Renaissance upgraded to Buy with a $425 target.

headline: Cloudflare up 3% as analysts split
summary: Closed at $315.00 (+3%). DZ Bank upgraded to Buy ($300 target); Guggenheim keeps Sell.

headline: Kospi +2.6%, SK hynix +5.4%; Korea chip exports +331% Nov 1-10
summary: Nikkei +1.3%. Samsung +3.4%, Kioxia +5.6%. Lower oil and Iran talk hopes helped.

headline: Anthropic sets terms: 825M shares at $70-78, about $61B raise
summary: About $1.2T fully diluted value at midpoint. Nasdaq ticker ANT; expected to price and trade week of Nov 16 (Nov 19 listing is Thu morning AEST Nov 20).

headline: Robinhood listed among retail brokers for the Anthropic IPO
summary: CFO says it is 'making sure the companies know retail is here'. Separately, the stock fell 8% on Oct 28 after a Q3 EPS miss.

headline: October CPI +0.4% m/m, core +0.3%, both above forecast
summary: S&P 500 -0.4%, Nasdaq -0.7%, Dow -0.3%. No y/y figure (2025 shutdown gap). Shelter over 30% of the rise. Gold -2.6%.

headline: Fed hike odds jump; Waller had flagged 50bp if core hit 0.3%
summary: Core came in at 0.3%. Logan backs at least two more 25bp hikes. Futures price a December hike as near certain.

headline: Anthropic sets IPO range $70-78, up to $1.4T valuation
summary: 825M shares on Nasdaq as ANT. Pricing expected Nov 18, trading Nov 19. Valuation below earlier $2T talk; book reportedly covered.

headline: Nasdaq-100 +3.4% while Nvidia lost about $200B
summary: CNBC: Nasdaq-100 was as oversold as at the March 30 low; SOX needs another 9% to clear its 20-day average.

headline: TSMC October revenue +59.7% y/y
summary: NT$586.9B, up 14.7% on September. Year to date up 43.3%.

headline: Anthropic aims for Nasdaq debut as ANT next week
summary: WSJ says trading targets Thursday or Friday, Nov 19-20, with Goldman and Morgan Stanley setting the range. Nvidia and Alphabet pledged $10B each at the IPO price.

headline: S&P 500 +2.35%, Nasdaq +2.74%, chip index +6.85%
summary: Best S&P day since April 8 after the worst week since April 2025. Dow +1,104. Brent -5.85% to $92.57. October CPI due Wednesday.

headline: Nvidia -4.3% as board probes CEO; chips rally without it
summary: Board opened an investigation into Jensen Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. Stock fell up to 8% intraday, lowest close since April 7.

headline: loanDepot Q3: loss widens to $29M, volume down 12%
summary: Revenue $307M (-9% q/q). Margin up 54bp to 399bp. Q4 volume guide $4.5-6.5B vs $7.05B in Q3. Seeking refinancing of debt maturities. Stock -17%.

headline: JPMorgan adds Meta to focus list; Meta +5%, Amazon +3%
summary: Meta and Amazon are JPMorgan's preferred internet picks; Alphabet removed but stays overweight. Meta Q3 ad revenue +26%.

headline: Marvell +9.5% with chips, no company news
summary: B. Riley cut target to $250, Cantor to $225 (neutral). Lumentum all-stock deal remains the overhang.

headline: Alibaba -3.8% on no news
summary: Fell against the rally. September-quarter results due Nov 19.

headline: Anthropic to set IPO range this week, trading next week
summary: WSJ via TechCrunch: some investors want below the $1.5T discussed last week, down from $2T floated months ago.

headline: Apple closes at record high
summary: Up about 2.4% on Monday.

headline: OpenAI closes first $11B of round at $1.25T
summary: The round could reach $20B, well below the original $30B target at a higher valuation. Later reports put the total at $15B.

headline: October payrolls rise 165,000, unemployment falls to 4.1%
summary: BLS: payrolls +165k against a 12-month average of 48k; hourly earnings +0.4% m/m, +3.1% y/y; August and September revised up a combined 84k.

headline: Reuters: traders hope tech storm blows out; Fed hike odds above 80%
summary: Thursday's 5.5% Nasdaq drop erased about $2.5 trillion on midterm AI-regulation and data-centre backlash fears. CPI Tuesday and PPI Friday next; Fed meets Dec 8-9.

headline: Chips lead partial rebound after record-scale selloff
summary: Tech was the best sector, +1.45%; NVDA +2.8%, MU +5.1%, MRVL +5.7% as the Nasdaq-100 rose 1.35%, while the S&P 500 still lost 2.7% on the week.

headline: Cloudflare up 9.9% after Q3 beat
summary: Q3 revenue $782.5M (+39%); Q4 guide about $845M. Stock closed $268.75.

headline: SK hynix falls another 10% in Seoul
summary: Down 10.4% to 1,132,000 won after -9.5% Nov 5, missing the US rebound.

headline: Chips bounce after worst day since 2020
summary: SOX fell 12.25% Nov 5; AMD rebounded 11%, ASML 5%, SOXX 3.5% on Nov 6.

headline: Chip stocks have worst day since 2020; Micron falls 17.5%
summary: The chip index fell 12.3% with all 30 members down. Micron fell 17.5%, Nvidia about 9%, also hit by a reported pause at a Taiwan plant over a labor dispute.

headline: Nasdaq enters correction as AI trade unwinds
summary: Nasdaq -5.5%, S&P 500 -4.4%, Dow -3.4%. Worry that new Democratic lawmakers will slow data center approvals. Goldman puts about 45% of planned US capacity in states likely to tighten rules.

headline: Marvell falls 16.4% in chip selloff
summary: Marvell closed down 16.4% and TSMC down 10.8% as chip and AI infrastructure names were sold.

headline: Cloudflare Q3 revenue up 39%, guide raised; shares up 15% after hours
summary: Q3 revenue $782.5M, up 39%. Q4 guide $845-846M; full-year raised to about $2.96B. Shares fell 8.3% in the session, then rose 14.7% after hours.

headline: Lumentum beats and guides next quarter up about 27%
summary: Revenue $1.26B, inside guidance. Next-quarter guide $1.575-1.625B. Positive read-across for optical AI networking. Lumentum fell 18.7% in the session, up 3.1% after hours.

headline: loanDepot falls 7.9% ahead of Nov 9 results
summary: No Q3 report yet; results due Nov 9. Shares fell another 4% after hours.

headline: Chip stocks have worst day since March 2020; Nasdaq enters correction
summary: SOXX fell about 11%. Nasdaq -5.2%, S&P 500 -3.9%, Dow down about 1,600 points. Traders fear a slower data-centre build-out after the Democratic midterm sweep. Nvidia and Broadcom were down about 9%, AMD and Micron about 15%.

headline: Memory names lead the losses: Micron -13%, SanDisk -20% midday
summary: AI infrastructure names fell across the board: CoreWeave -12%, Corning -13%, Lumentum -14%, Astera Labs -15%.

headline: Investors question how hyperscalers are funding AI capex
summary: Barclays cites concern about how long the AI infrastructure supercycle can last. SOXX is down more than 23% in a month, while the Dow is up 4.1%. Goldman says a Democratic Congress could make data-centre builds slower and costlier.

headline: 10-year yield falls to 4.83%, 2-year down 10bp
summary: Investors moved into Treasuries during the tech selloff. October payrolls are due Friday, with a 59k gain expected. Jobless claims came in at 189k.

headline: Barkin expects further gradual rate hikes
summary: Richmond Fed President Barkin named inflation as the top risk, said AI is adding to price pressures, and flagged more than $500bn of hyperscaler debt as worth watching. He is not a voter until 2027.

headline: MercadoLibre Q3: revenue +45%, operating income -6%
summary: Revenue $10.75B; margin 6.3%; EPS $8.83; TPV +53%; credit book +62%. Stock about -13% intraday.

headline: AI chips sell off on midterm data-centre fears
summary: S&P about -3.5% and Nasdaq -4.7% midday; AMD -14.6%, NVDA -7.5%, CoreWeave -12.1%; Kospi -5.3%. 10-yr yield 4.83%.

headline: Democrats win Congress; stocks rally, oil falls over 8%
summary: Dow up about 2.9%, S&P 500 up 1.8%, Nasdaq up 1.9% intraday. 10-year yield down a few bps near 4.9%. Crude down more than 8% on pressure to end the Iran war.

headline: AI power stocks slide after Democrats win Congress and Texas governor
summary: Vertiv fell about 14% intraday, GE Vernova about 10%, Bloom Energy about 8%. Gina Hinojosa won Texas on a data-centre moratorium pledge; Texas holds about 25-30% of planned US data-centre GW. Bernstein calls the risk overstated.

headline: Argus cuts GE Vernova target to $1,100 from $1,300, keeps Buy
summary: Stock opened at $855.25 against a $918.20 prior close and fell about 10% intraday with AI-power names.

headline: Astera Labs Q3 revenue $584.9M, guides Q4 to $730-750M
summary: Revenue +154% y/y and above the $540-560M guide; non-GAAP EPS $1.32. Q4 guide implies about +26% q/q. Shares still fell about 6% Nov 4 with AI infrastructure.

headline: AMD data-centre revenue +97%; guides Q4 to about $17B
summary: Q3 revenue $13.4B, data centre $8.5B, non-GAAP EPS $2.09 vs $1.95 expected. Q4 guide about +66% y/y with 55% gross margin; RBC says 2-4% above consensus.

headline: Nvidia reportedly tells cloud partners to cap Chinese customers at 49%
summary: FT report: new contracts must sell at least 51% of services to non-Chinese firms; existing deals not affected. Nvidia did not confirm. Nvidia was about 1% lower Nov 4.

headline: Apple beats on Q4 but guides margins lower on memory costs
summary: Revenue rose 12% and iPhone revenue rose 17.5%. Gross margin guidance of 45-46% for December was below the 46.3% analysts expected, and shares fell about 3% after hours.

headline: Bloom up about 11% on Barclays upgrade and 1 GW MOU
summary: Barclays to Overweight, $289 target; non-binding MOU with California Resources for at least 1 GW of fuel cells with carbon capture.

headline: JPMorgan upgrades Cloudflare to Overweight
summary: Target $350; results Thursday Nov 5.

headline: SK hynix about -5% as KOSPI drops over 3%
summary: Korea memory names fell early Tuesday after Monday's 3.4% SOX slide.

headline: RBA hikes to 4.85% in a 6-3 vote
summary: Second hike in two meetings; inflation seen above band until late 2027.

headline: Oil slips as Iran-Qatar talks continue for a third day
summary: Brent was down 1.4%. Iran's foreign minister called the talks 'ongoing and progressing'. Oil later fell more than 8% overnight into Nov 5 on expectations of pressure to end the war.

headline: Marvell falls 13% and Lumentum 19% on the all-stock megadeal
summary: Investors questioned the 115B all-stock purchase. Because Lumentum holders get a fixed 4.5 Marvell shares each, Lumentum fell with Marvell.

headline: Chips sold off Monday: MU -5.8%, NVDA -1.3%, AMZN +2.2%
summary: Money rotated out of tech, and the Nasdaq fell 1.1% while the Dow rose. Apple fell 1.8% in the regular session ahead of its results.

headline: Apple beats on revenue, guides margin 45-46% on memory costs
summary: Revenue $114.5B, iPhone +17%; Greater China missed; shares lower Tuesday.

headline: Palantir revenue +96% to $2.313B, FY guide raised
summary: Q4 guide $2.649-2.653B; US commercial +148%.

headline: Marvell signs all-stock deal to buy Lumentum
summary: Fixed 4.5 Marvell shares per Lumentum share, about a 24% premium to the Oct 28 close. Marvell holders keep about 67%, the deal is expected to close in 1H 2028, and Q3 revenue guidance holds with the range narrowed to plus or minus 2%.

headline: Marvell down 9.5%, Lumentum down 15% by 1pm ET
summary: Both stocks fell through the session after the deal news. Indexes were up 0.3-0.9% as oil fell over 7%.
